scientific limitations/integrity: The theorem treats all finite extremal unit-diameter configurations in three dimensions and one designated exposed circular dual-edge pair. It determines the uniquely optimal finite partition for fixed subdivision count and proves that the global supremum over all finite extremal sets is not attained. It does not compute that supremum or solve the constant-width area conjecture, and it does not determine the best overall configuration at any fixed vertex count. The geometric dangling-insertion incidence rule and the spherical-supremum bound are taken from the primary source; strictness, optimal equal-angle placement, and inverse-square rates are established directly.
title: Optimal dangling-edge refinement and nonattainment of dual-edge product suprema
